issue.title: [chassis] white listed logs are getting ignored by loganalyzer for multi asic device

failure.body:
**Description**

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**

2. The test is marked as error with the below logs

                    p_traceback = process['exception'][1]

                    'Processes "{}" failed with exit code "{}"\nException:\n{}\nTraceback:\n{}'.format(
>                       list(failed_processes.keys()), p_exitcode, p_exception, p_traceback

resolution.title: [chassis][multi-asic] update the loganalyser regex for multi asic
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Arvindsrinivasan Lakshmi Narasimhan <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #6884
### Type of change

- [ x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012
- [x ] 202205

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
In multi asic platforms in the syslog messages  the container name has the asic id in it
forexample log from swss is as below
```
Nov 19 <IPV6>.566409 str2-sonic-lc5-1 ERR swss1#orchagent: :- getResAvailability: Failed to get availability counter for NEXTHOP_GROUP_MAP CRM resourse
```
The current regex we have in [loganalyzer_common_ignore.txt](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/roles/test/files/tools/loganalyzer/loganalyzer_common_ignore.txt) fails to whitelist the log messages on multi asic platform.

#### How did you do it?
Update the regex in the [loganalyzer_common_ignore.txt](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/roles/test/files/tools/loganalyzer/loganalyzer_common_ignore.txt) to support multi asic platform

#### How did you verify/test it?
Run the test with loganalyzer and check if logs are ignore properly

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
